title: Linearity of expectation under subtraction
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. Then $\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[f-g]=\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[f]-\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[g]$.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued functions $f$ and $g$ on the sample space
